reviews.x: This product worked AMAZINGLY well on my strong, straightened hair! I washed it at night, only towel dried it, put a curling gel in it, then used the curlers as directed. I slept in the curlers overnight and took them out in the morning with fabulous, tight curls. I would highly recommend this product for anyone looking for tight, bouncy curls that last for days.

This works good, it has rubber parts to keep it in the hair so be aware because can take off hair easily I broke a few trying to figured out how to apply and taking it off. I dont recommend it for thin and fragile hair. It comes woth enough tubes for a full head so I think worth the cost

I have extremely thick and almost waist length hair. It takes a holds a curl really well but is exhausting to curl. I decided to give these a try. I was really skeptical about how well these would work or how easy they would be to use,  not to mention I was unsure if there would be enough in one package for all my hair. I was very impressed at how easy they were to use and how comfortable they were, and straight shook with how great the curls work and have already recommended them to friends.
Works great. Just be sure not to put to much hair in one and when removing pinch the top

Simple product, I t gives good curls/waves. Not a very tight curl unless you use a good product. Be sure to order appropriate to your length. If your hair is shorter thats alright, but if your hair is longer, order a longer set.

I owned a similar set of curlers when my daughter was younger. They are so easy to use. She loves to out her hair in a high pony, put the curlers in her hair, and just leave it up when they are ready to take out.
This product really works but best for longer hair.  Comfy to sleep in and easy to take out.

reviews.t: I’m a Hair Stylist and was curious about these.
reviews.x: These curlers are good for people who have a hard time with standard rollers. Frankly, for straight hair it is far less effort to use a curling wand. With the right sectioning and product, you will get a better curl that way...and way faster.  Tips: Your hair should be damp. If you try to pull your hair through these dry, it will be painful and potentially damage your hair. You might want to start the curl a couple of inches or more away from the root so you don’t get a weird kink. When you are

I am a hairdresser and have tried many heatless options to get curls, all of which left undesirable results, especially at the ends of the curls.  This is a great product, uniform curls and the ends are seamless.  This was the least expensive set I could find, that's why I went with it.  If you have a ton of hair, you may need two sets.  My hair is shoulder length and relatively thick, I had JUST enough.
These didn't work at all. My hair got stuck in them repeatedly. You need to use super small sections of hair....it takes longer to put them in then to just curl your hair. I'm returning this item.

I got these as an easy way to set my hair overnight, as I have been doing wet sets and curled sets to sleep in for years. The spirals have to be directed by hand many times so that they do not tangle, the set had some slip off in my sleep but the rest of my head was so uncomfortable (worse than sponge set sleeping!). If these were softer, it miiight be worth it. Alas, much hair pulling, de-tangling spirals, and bad sleep later, I will not be using these again.

I have very fine thin hair! It takes a lot of hairspray to make curls stay when using a curling iron. With theses magic curlers my curls lasted most of the day and I didn’t have to use the whole can of hairspray!  The only downside was sleeping with them in, it was not very comfortable. But hey they say beauty is pain! Lol

reviews.t: You might need 2 sets if you have a lot of hair
reviews.x: I have long and thick hair. 1 set is not enough for all my hair. It can be difficult to get your hair through the curl formers. I recommend watching a few YouTube tutorials before trying to use them. The final product usually looks like ringlets

I don’t always have time to do my hair when I get up so I thought these would be super helpful in giving me a nice style without spending an hour in the morning to do my hair. These hair curlers don’t come with any instructions whatsoever and just in a plastic non resealable bag. Which is a little annoying. reviews.t: Tool for pulling hair through isn't long enough
reviews.x: The tool to pull the hair through doesn't seem to go with this set. It's about 4 or so inches too short to fit through the former properly, which causes tangles trying to get it through. I realize I could simply jerry-rig an extension for it, but when I bought the curl formers for long hair, I expected all parts to be for long hair. It's really inconvenient to have an added struggle with a purchase meant to make life a tiny bit easier.

The stick that you use to pull hair through is a cheap plastic, comes in two pieces and they click together to form one. It breaks apart as you’re trying to pull hair through and our has already refused to stay together after just two uses. Hard to sleep in, unless you’re a heavy sleeper. Picture: curlers used overnight on damp hair, pic was taken at about 6 hours of wear in a humid climate and still has some curl.

I couldnt use this product. My hair just ripped and tore trying. The one I got in was awkward but did curl my hair, but because it wasnt smooth, it just looked matted up. If you can get the product to work, I have no doubt it curls hair. It just didnt work for my super straight, fine hair.
These curlers are amazing! No heat damage to hair, you can sleep in them, and the curls are even better than when I use a wand. Highly recommended!
Despite the late arrival only due to the pandemic , seller was very responsive . Tried out the curlers and it’s worth the money

reviews.t: Harder to use than I anticipated
reviews.x: I found it downright difficult to put them in my hair. I think to use on someone else would be much easier.
It made my hair curly overnight ! And I'm not talking waves I mean CURLS FOR DAYS, thanks amazon
This is an amazing product.  So easy to you and at a very reasonable price.  Love it!
I love these magic hair curlers, because it can keep our hair neat yet fashionable.

claims.text: Most reviewers say the curlers work well and produce good curls, waves, or ringlets.
Several reviewers find them uncomfortable to sleep in or difficult and time-consuming to put in, with hair tangling or snagging.
Some reviewers note they work best for longer or thicker hair, and that one set may not be enough for a lot of hair.
A few reviewers mention needing the right technique or product, and some recommend watching tutorials or using small sections.
Some reviewers highlight that they are a good heatless alternative to heat styling.
